mutation_protocol.application_model: Apply exactly one deterministic transformation to an otherwise conforming abstract observation set; keep all fields not named by the injection unchanged.
mutation_protocol.unknown_rule: Every mutant carries enough public or structural evidence for a decision, so Unknown does not satisfy a negative mutant.

mutants.mutation: Restore the historical luma() fallback to white.
mutants.validity_basis: D01 freezes a required missing-lightness diagnostic and hint for the empty call.

witness.predicate: luma() emits the frozen missing-lightness diagnostic and hint
witness.expected_observed: a value is returned instead of a diagnostic

mutants.mutation: Restore white fallback for an invalid component type.
mutants.validity_basis: D02 and D03 freeze public string-type diagnostics for both lightness and alpha positions.

witness.predicate: invalid string lightness propagates expected integer or ratio, found string
witness.expected_observed: white value replaces the required type diagnostic

mutants.mutation: Restore white fallback for an out-of-range numeric lightness.
mutants.validity_basis: D04 freezes the integer-range diagnostic at the lower invalid neighbor.

witness.predicate: luma(-1) emits number must be between 0 and 255
witness.expected_observed: white value replaces the required range diagnostic

mutants.mutation: Keep alpha exclusively named and reject the required second positional forms.
mutants.validity_basis: V04 through V07 require positional alpha while D13 requires named alpha rejection.

deterministic_injection.target: V04 and D13 observations in every profile
deterministic_injection.operation: set V04 to unexpected-positional DIAGNOSTIC and set D13 to VALUE luma(50.2%, 40%)

witness.predicate: second positional alpha is accepted and alpha: is rejected
witness.expected_observed: the two public syntactic forms have inverted acceptance

mutants.mutation: Accept alpha: in addition to the correct second positional form.
mutants.validity_basis: The frozen protocol forbids every named argument, including alpha:.

deterministic_injection.operation: replace DIAGNOSTIC unexpected argument: alpha with VALUE

witness.predicate: luma(128, alpha: 40%) emits unexpected argument: alpha

mutants.mutation: Accept ratio alpha but reject integer alpha.
mutants.validity_basis: Component admits both Ratio 0%–100% and Int 0–255; V05–V07 freeze integer-alpha values.

deterministic_injection.operation: replace VALUE luma(15.69%, 49.8%) with type DIAGNOSTIC while leaving V04 ratio alpha preserved

witness.expected_observed: ratio alpha passes but in-range integer alpha is rejected

mutants.mutation: Accept integer alpha outside the inclusive 0–255 range.
mutants.validity_basis: D06 and D07 freeze rejection on both immediate integer neighbors.

deterministic_injection.operation: replace DIAGNOSTIC number must be between 0 and 255 with any complete VALUE

witness.predicate: luma(10%, 256) emits number must be between 0 and 255
witness.expected_observed: out-of-range integer alpha produces a value

mutants.mutation: Keep the empty-call error message but omit its required remediation hint.
mutants.validity_basis: The hint is an explicitly frozen public diagnostic observable, not optional metadata.

deterministic_injection.operation: set hint=null while retaining message missing argument: lightness component

mutants.mutation: Change luma(color) in this numeric-protocol lot so the crystalline alpha no longer remains 40%.
mutants.validity_basis: P01 freezes the current crystalline public value as an explicit scope-out preservation control.

deterministic_injection.target: P01_LUMA_COLOR_ALPHA_SCOPE_OUT candidate observation in every profile

witness.predicate: candidate crystalline luma(rgb(...,40%)).components() equals the frozen pre-candidate crystalline value
witness.expected_observed: alpha changes from 40% to 100% inside the excluded scope

mutants.mutation: Replace a canonical language-value comparison with Rust structural equality or rendered-byte equality.

witness.expected_observed: verdict has only a mechanical comparison basis and no language comparison
